In this video Top Gear looks at the New Hennessey Blackbird hypercar – and it’s a hypercar unlike any other! Because rather than coming with more power than its predecessor, the Blackbird actually has less, over 1200bhp less than the Venom F5 Evolution. Think over 800bhp from a naturally aspirated 6.2 V8 that’ll rev over 9000rpm – which will make it the most powerful N/A V8 in production – plus rear-wheel drive, a manual gearbox and an interior devoid of any digital screens. In essence, it’s very much an analogue hypercar then, a sort of American GMA T.50…
